description: Import a Slack thread's prior discussion as bounded, first-launch-only agent startup context: add the reusable Agent API startup-context channel (field threading + server-side read-only composition + fingerprint-exclusion), then have the Slack Connection read thread history on first mention, truncate oldest-first with explicit marking, refuse on incomplete read, and keep accepted input immutable.

tasks.title: Add the Agent API startup-context channel and server-side read-only composition
tasks.description: Thread a new optional startup-context value through the launch chain (launcher parameter -> AgentLaunchCoordinatorRequest -> plan -> EnsureInitialLaunchCommand -> AgentSessionInputRecord -> AgentJobInput) using append-only Orleans field ids. Persist it on the coordinator plan for recovery but exclude it from the launch fingerprint. At dispatch (BuildDispatch), compose the context as an explicit read-only background block preceding the task prompt, keeping AgentJobInput.Prompt and AgentSessionInputRecord.Text task-only so the work label stays clean. Cover all three requirements of the agent-startup-context capability with spec/unit tests.
acceptanceCriteria: A new optional startup-context value threads through the entire launch chain as append-only Orleans field ids; a launch that omits it produces byte-identical plan, fingerprint, session input, and dispatch payload as before this change.
The coordinator fingerprint is unchanged when only the startup context varies (background excluded), while existing prompt/attachment/connection-origin fingerprint behavior is preserved.
The startup context is persisted on the coordinator plan so a recovery replay reuses the same snapshot rather than recomputing it.

At dispatch the startup context is composed as an explicit read-only background block preceding the task prompt; the resolved Instructions, Runtime, Model, Variant, and Skills on the dispatched AgentJobInput are identical with and without the context.
A truncation marker carried with the context reaches both the composed agent input and the session input audit record.
Follow-up inputs to the same session do not carry, replace, or append any startup context.

Spec/unit tests (no real Slack, injectable time) cover: launch-with-context composition, instructions/capabilities immutability, fingerprint-exclusion across varying background, first-launch-only behavior, and truncation-marker propagation.
tasks.output: Startup-context field threaded through the launch chain with server-side read-only composition at dispatch, plus passing server spec/unit tests.
tasks.notes: Reuse the read-only-background framing already proven by runner `composeOpencodePrompt` (opencode.ts), but compose server-side in BuildDispatch so no runner contract change is needed and Prompt stays task-only for the work label (AgentJobGrain.cs:1543). Background is a volatile snapshot, so unlike AttachmentIds it must NOT enter the fingerprint; dedup stays on Slack message identity. Mirror how Attachments/Provenance were added as append-only [Id(n)].

tasks.title: Import bounded Slack thread history as startup context on first mention
tasks.description: On the first @Bot mention in an existing thread with prior readable messages and no binding, read the bounded Bot-visible thread history via a new ISlackApiClient.ConversationsRepliesAsync using the connection's decrypted bot token, and supply it as startup context through the T-001 channel; the mention message is the explicit task. Apply oldest-message-first truncation to a configurable character budget (SlackProviderOptions) with a pagination depth cap, marking truncation in both the Slack acceptance reply and the agent input. Refuse (no AgentJob, release the launch reservation) on any read failure. Preserve the empty-mention rejection and edit/delete immutability. Update the 实装差距 notes on delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: On the first @Bot mention in a thread with prior readable messages and no existing binding, the Server reads the bounded thread history via the new ISlackApiClient conversations.replies method using the decrypted bot token (SecretStoreAddress(projectId, connectionId, BotToken)) and supplies it as startup context; the mention text minus the bot mention is the explicit task.

A root mention in a brand-new thread (no prior readable messages) imports no startup context and launches on the task text alone; a mention in an already-bound thread is treated as a follow-up and imports nothing.

Over-limit history drops the oldest whole messages first to the configured character budget with a stable truncation marker; the marker appears in BOTH the Slack acceptance reply and the agent input, with no silent loss.

On a read failure (Slack error such as missing_scope/not_in_channel, rate-limiting, or transport failure) no AgentJob or AgentSession is created, no history is imported, the launch reservation is released, and the user is asked to re-mention later; a deliberate truncation to fit the budget does not trigger a refusal.
A first mention with no task text and no attachments still creates no work and asks the user to send a task (existing behavior preserved on the thread-context path).
Later Slack edits or deletes of already-imported messages do not re-run, undo, or rewrite the accepted input or audit record; correction is only via a follow-up input.
The acceptance reply for an importing launch states that prior thread discussion is being used as background, and notes truncation when it occurs.

Spec/unit tests (fake ISlackApiClient + fake ISecretStore, injectable time) cover: import-on-first-mention, root-mention-no-import, oldest-first truncation with dual marking, refuse-on-incomplete (no AgentJob and reservation released), empty-mention rejection, and edit/delete immutability.
The 实装差距 notes in docs/agent-connections.md and design/slack-agent-connection.md are updated to mark thread-history import as provided.
tasks.output: Slack first-mention thread-history import with truncation, refuse-on-incomplete, and immutability, plus passing server tests and updated gap notes.
tasks.notes: Reading is Server-side (D1): the Server already calls 7 Slack read APIs with the bot token; conversations.replies is mechanically identical and the adapter has no inbound RPC. Wire the read into the first-mention-in-existing-thread branch (SlackConnectionRoutes.cs ~1177-1183 -> LaunchChannelRootAsync) after the existing empty-mention and access checks. Background scope is all Bot-visible messages strictly before the mention by ts (D6). On the refuse path the launch reservation MUST be released so a later re-mention can proceed. A successful read of the visible set is 'complete'; visibility gaps are not fetch failures (D5).
